items.html: And behold, it is known that the name BaN is Gevura and the Achoraim. And with this you will understand that the externality, which divides into three vessels, is the essence called "body." And in each of its aspects there are mochin, as above; and they are clothed within the three aspects of the NNH of Ima of her externality as well, namely within Tevuna; and likewise, in this manner, three aspects for the internality. And their mochin then enter, clothed within the three aspects of the internality of the NNH of Ima as well. And the three inner aspects are within the three external aspects; and the externality is called "body," and the internality is called "voice."
